reason: I'd like the magnesium, but I've never heard of this brand and nobody has reviewed it yet. Paying £19.99 now for something that won't ship until January, when Boots and Holland & Barrett will have their own deals on magnesium, is not how I shop.
objection: It's a gummy, so it's full of sugar and glucose syrup, and I'd be taking it every day. Add that to a brand with no reviews and money taken before anything arrives, and I'm not going to pre-order.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from women my age who've taken it for a few weeks, and a price that matches the high-street deals, or a shipping date I can trust.
